purpose: Replicate the development finding that temporary underground disruption changes the subsequent reproductive trajectory of a live insurgency before materially changing its already-fielded force.

design.post_intervention: Both branches run with underground disruption rate zero from day 240 through day 360.

primary_predictions: Mean cell-001 minus cell-000 rooted armed membership is negative at day 240.
At least 12 of 16 seeds have lower rooted armed membership under U at day 240.
Mean cell-001 minus cell-000 rooted armed membership remains negative at day 360.
At least 10 of 16 seeds have lower rooted armed membership under U at day 360.
At day 240, the absolute proportional effect on fielded force is smaller than the absolute proportional effect on rooted armed membership.
Mean proportional fielded-force effect becomes more negative from day 240 to day 360.
Among seeds with positive direct disruption mass, the median day-360 amplification ratio (-rooted_effect_day360 / cumulative_underground_disruption_day240) exceeds 1.0.
At least 8 of 16 seeds have a negative rooted-membership effect at both day 240 and day 360 with a larger absolute proportional gap at day 360.
heterogeneity_analysis: Report the fraction of seeds that rebound past baseline by day 360.
Report seed-level day-240 and day-360 rooted effects, fielded-force effects, direct disruption mass, persistence ratio, and amplification ratio.
Report correlations between day-240 and day-360 rooted effects as exploratory diagnostics only; do not promote baseline-state predictors from the eight-seed development set to confirmatory status.
integrity_gate: Exactly 16 seeds x 2 cells x 3 timepoints must be present once each.
Every within-seed day-60 scientific output must be identical across cells 000 and 001.
The treatment-factor flags must match the cell codes.
interpretation_guard: This tests a synthetic Pineland mechanism: reproductive-pool suppression, lagged coercive-capacity response, and persistence after intervention removal. It is not a real-world operational recommendation.
